name: Lanna Thai Imbiss
kurzbeschreibung:
**Lanna Thai Takeaway in Kitzbühel** – Enjoy authentic Thai flavors in the heart of the Alps! From spicy curries to fresh spring rolls, our small but cozy spot serves up delicious dishes made with love. Try our famous **Pad Thai** or a hearty **Green Curry**—perfect after a day on the slopes or a stroll through Kitzbühel’s charming streets. Quick, tasty, and always fresh—your taste buds will thank you!

**Opening hours:**
Mon–Fri: 11:30 AM – 9:00 PM
Sat: 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM
Sun: Closed

**Location:** Near the **Kitzbüheler Hornbahn** – just a short walk from the center.

**Takeaway & Eat-in** – Come for the food, stay for the vibe! 🌶️✨
